description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Shrouding Spells: after you cast an action spell with a slot, the module offers Dash and Hide as a Bonus Action: your Speed doubles this turn and it rolls Stealth (DC 15 makes you Invisible). Uses = your spellcasting modifier per Long Rest. Sneaky Casting: by hand.

system.requirements: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Shrouding Spells Bonus Action Dash + Hide offered by the module (uses = spellcasting modifier / LR).
